thread:
Taylor Brooks: hey everyone, quick onboarding snag — i can log into the Redwood workspace but the "Team Templates" and onboarding checklist don't show up in my sidebar. anyone know who owns those pages or a fast way to get access? :sweat_smile:

Olivia Park: welcome Taylor! :wave: Owners vary by doc. Onboarding checklist is People Ops, templates are split by team (Engineering -> eng-docs, Product -> product-ops). If pages are missing it's usually an SSO mapping issue or the pages are restricted.

Kai Morgan: +1 to SSO. quick debug: open the invite email and confirm the account matches your SSO email, then try an incognito window. If pages still 403, file the docs-perms form with URLs or ping the owner. I can add viewer access to the "New hire checklist" if you need immediate access.

Taylor Brooks: incognito didn't help. i filed the form but might need to edit the checklist for my first-week goals. can you add edit?

Olivia Park: Usually we add view first then grant edit after a short review. If it's urgent, reply here with exact page names and i'll escalate. Also: duplicate templates before editing.

Taylor Brooks: page names: "New hire checklist" and "First-week goals (template)". thanks!

notion-bot: Ticket DOCS-9512 created for Taylor Brooks requesting edit access on "New hire checklist" and "First-week goals (template)". Owner: People Ops. ETA: 1 business day.

Kai Morgan: added Taylor as viewer on both pages. i also dropped a comment on the checklist asking People Ops to approve edit. once approved, i'll give editor rights. Reminder: to edit a template, Duplicate -> Move to your Team space -> Edit the copy.

Taylor Brooks: can confirm i can view and duplicated the first-week goals. thanks so much! one little Q: where are the PR and handoff templates for engineers?

Olivia Park: eng templates live under Engineering > Team Templates (PR checklist, Handoff). owners = eng-docs. duplicate the PR checklist into your repo docs and replace any team-specific links.

Taylor Brooks: perfect. appreciate the quick help :raised_hands:

notion-bot: DOCS-9512 updated: People Ops approved edit access for Taylor Brooks on the requested pages. Status: edit granted.

Kai Morgan: done — Taylor now has edit on the checklist. ping me if you want a 15-min walkthrough on duplicating and sharing templates.
